summary: A 1932 L-4 cab on a concrete base on the Boise National Forest, later converted to a radio building; drive-up and repurposed. Not the Payette Pilot Peak.

facts.design: L-4 cab with catwalk on a 10-foot concrete base (NHLR; Firelookout.com)
facts.status_note: Firelookout.com says it was converted to a radio building; Idaho Fire Lookouts tags it Repurposed. NHLR (2011) describes it in active use.

staffing.status: known staff listed for 1964 and 1974-1982; no current staffing stated

visit.trail_note: Listed as drive-up on Idaho Fire Lookouts. Firelookout.com places it 9 miles SSW of Lowman. No public-access rule found in the sources.

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Boise National Forest

corrections.proposed: L-4 cab on a concrete base (single cab; not described as two-story)
corrections.why: Every Boise-tower source describes an L-4 cab on a concrete base. None calls this tower two-story. The two-story descriptions I saw in search snippets were on other pages I could not confirm for this tower.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Two lookouts are named Pilot Peak. The Boise National Forest tower (NHLR US 934, Boise County, 8,128 ft, 1932 L-4 cab) is the subject. The Payette National Forest tower (NHLR US 1453, Valley County, 8,075 ft, 1919 log cabin, 1954 L-4 tower, staffed in fire season) is a separate record and is not used for facts here.

notes_for_editor: Two-story claim: the brief's kind 'two_story' is not supported by any page read for the Boise tower; corrections proposes a change for a human to decide. Weebly Forest Lookouts pages (idaholookouts.weebly.com/pilot-peak.html and /pilot-peak1.html) were read only as their county index, so their Pilot Peak sections were not verified. A search snippet from pilot-peak1 lists '1932: A log lookout house constructed' and '1954: A two-story cinder block and standard L-4 cabin constructed' and mentions a 1985 Savage Creek fire; none of this is cited or used because it cannot be tied to this tower from what was read. Recommend a targeted read of the weebly pilot-peak pages to settle the two-story question and any fire history. Access level left unset: no source states public access rules. Known-staff names are not included in the story. Converted-to-radio date is not given by any source, so no event is listed for it. Staffing as_of is the access date because the Idaho Fire Lookouts list is undated. The Payette tower's Idaho Fire Lookouts page (west-central/pilot-peak-lookout) appeared in search only and was not read.
